answer: Randomized Entry Windows. Each identity registers by submitting a hash commitment, then must submit a reveal transaction inside a short window whose start block is drawn from a beacon the attacker cannot predict; a yarrow-seeded VRF mixes validator signatures with prior block entropy. Miss the window and the registration expires. The window opens unpredictably, so an attacker must keep capital and monitoring live across every block of a canyon of waiting time, paying continuous gas and idle liquidity per clone. Unrevealed entries forfeit their deposit to the river of honest registrants,
